waypoints.name: Octavia E. Butler Landing
waypoints.geological_context: Perseverance touchdown site on crater floor regolith over Máaz formation basaltic flows.
waypoints.crism_signature: Low albedo pyroxene-bearing basaltic crater floor.
waypoints.pds_citation: Farley, K.A. et al. (2022), Science 377, eabo2196; NASA Mars 2020 EDL Report.

waypoints.name: Three Forks Sample Depot
waypoints.geological_context: Flat delta-front terrain selected for humanity's first extraterrestrial sample cache (10 titanium tubes deposited Sols 653-690).
waypoints.crism_signature: Contact zone between crater floor olivine-carbonate and fine-grained deltaic mudstones.
waypoints.pds_citation: NASA Mars 2020 Sample Depot Science Verification, JPL D-104928.

waypoints.name: Hawksbill Gap Delta Ascent
waypoints.geological_context: Prominent incised channel through the delta scarp exposing finely laminated mudstones (Wildcat Ridge). Primary biosignature target.
waypoints.crism_signature: Strong Fe/Mg smectite clay and sulfate absorption bands at 1.9 and 2.3 microns (CRISM FRT000047A3).
waypoints.pds_citation: Scheller, E.L. et al. (2022), Science 378, 1105-1110; CRISM PDS Geosciences Node.

waypoints.name: Kodiak Butte Outlier
waypoints.geological_context: Erosional mesa exhibiting classic delta foreset and topset sedimentary bedding, proving an ancient lacustrine delta system.
waypoints.crism_signature: Layered clay and smectite signatures on weathered scarp faces.

waypoints.name: Delta Rim Overlook (Tenby)
waypoints.geological_context: Elevated scarp rim atop the western delta providing strategic line-of-sight and access to upper delta channel deposits.
waypoints.crism_signature: Carbonate-bearing olivine unit and hydrated silica lag deposits.

waypoints.name: Neretva Vallis Inflow Margin
waypoints.geological_context: Coarse boulder conglomerate and braided channel deposits from high-energy catastrophic flood breaches entering Jezero crater.
waypoints.crism_signature: Diverse mineralogical mixture including polyhydrated sulfates and aluminum phyllosilicates.
waypoints.pds_citation: Goudge, T.A. et al. (2015), JGR Planets 120, 775-797.

waypoints.name: Séítah Sand Dune Margin
waypoints.geological_context: Layered olivine-rich cumulate rocks interleaved with rippled aeolian sand dunes; high rover wheel sinkage hazard.
waypoints.crism_signature: Strong olivine signature at 1.05 microns with basaltic pyroxene sand.
waypoints.pds_citation: Wiens, R.C. et al. (2022), Science Advances 8, eabo3399.

waypoints.name: Artuby Ridge Scarp
waypoints.geological_context: Prominent fractured ridge defining the boundary between the Séítah and Máaz formations.
waypoints.crism_signature: Carbonate-bearing olivine bedrock with pyroxene veneers.

waypoints.name: Skinner Ridge Delta Base
waypoints.geological_context: Finely layered sedimentary outcrop where abrasion patch 'Swift Run' revealed abundant sulfate minerals.
waypoints.crism_signature: Hydrated silica and smectite clay spectral features.
waypoints.pds_citation: Farley, K.A. et al. (2023), JGR Planets 128, e2022JE007627.

waypoints.name: Enchanted Lake Outcrop
waypoints.geological_context: Base of the delta scarp displaying laminated mudstones deposited in quiet lacustrine conditions.
waypoints.crism_signature: Fe/Mg smectite and magnesium carbonate absorption bands.
waypoints.pds_citation: Stack, K.M. et al. (2020), Space Sci. Rev. 216, 127.

waypoints.name: Belva Crater Rim Overlook
waypoints.geological_context: Raised rim of the 1-km impact crater Belva excavated into delta topset beds, exposing 3D stratigraphy.
waypoints.crism_signature: Mixed olivine-carbonate conglomerates and impact melt sheets.
waypoints.pds_citation: Beyssac, O. et al. (2023), JGR Planets 128, e2022JE007705.

waypoints.name: Dourbes Floor Sampling Site
waypoints.geological_context: Basaltic Máaz unit sampled during initial crater floor exploration (cored sample 'Montdenier').
waypoints.pds_citation: Simon, J.I. et al. (2023), JGR Planets 128, e2022JE007474.
